defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Corrosive Spines
offensiveAbilities.description: With impressive control, the surnoch can launch its spines in a tight grouping over a great distance. All creatures in a 30ft Type:line take 8d8 Piercing Damage damage with a Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature also takes 1d8 Persistent,acid Damage damage (or 2d8 Persistent,acid Damage damage on a critical failure). The surnoch can't use Corrosive Spines again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surnoch's Kiss
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Sickened 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Sickened 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Sickened 3 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Tail Smash
offensiveAbilities.description: The surnoch's tail smash has a burst centered on a corner of its space. It's excluded from the burst.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tunneling Expert
offensiveAbilities.description: Surnochs have adapted to move swiftly underground. When burrowing, a surnoch worm leaves a tunnel behind itself. When moving through a previously created surnoch tunnel, it gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed.
